info.title: Rebrickable Universal API
info.description: Access Rebrickable's LEGO catalog data for sets, parts, colors, themes, minifigs, badges, and related inventory lookups through the Rebrickable API.

get.description: Retrieves a badge from Rebrickable by ID.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique Rebrickable badge ID.

schema.description: Unique Rebrickable badge ID.

parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
